integrity: Analytic proof uses Hanner and Clarkson inequalities and explicit Rademacher/disjoint weakly null witnesses. Companion numerical checks are finite and nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar sigma-finite infinite-dimensional Lp spaces, 1<p<infinity, fixed norm-one base vector and pointwise sequential symmetric weak-null infimum; does not claim a general finite-codimensional asymptotic modulus or an independent originality verification. Full-text access to a pertinent 2017 AMUC paper was unavailable.
title: Sharp weak-null symmetric perturbation profiles in real \(L_p\) spaces
